title: Hearty Peppery Greek Lamb Keftedes
description: A festive Greek dish featuring lamb keftedes with a peppery twist, served in a stone bowl with savoiardi ladyfingers on the side.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground lamb, chopped onion, minced garlic, black pepper, salt, and dried oregano.
Mix the ingredients together with your hands until just combined.
Use your hands to shape the mixture into small keftedes, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Place the keftedes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the keftedes in the preheated oven for 18 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the keftedes are baking, prepare the stone bowl by heating it in the oven for 5 minutes.
Remove the keftedes from the oven and place them in the heated stone bowl.
Serve the keftedes hot, garnished with lemon wedges and accompanied by savoiardi ladyfingers on the side.
